mapper.sql: left join basket_member_account acc on acc.id = c.member_id and acc.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = c.member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 left join basket_player_profile p on p.id = c.player_id and p.is_delete = 0
mapper.select:
select c.id, c.change_no as changeNo, c.member_id as memberId, acc.account_no as accountNo, c.player_id as playerId, p.player_no as playerNo, mp.nickname as submitUserName, acc.email as submitUserEmail, c.old_nickname as oldNickname, c.new_nickname as newNickname, c.old_avatar_url as oldAvatarUrl, c.new_avatar_url as newAvatarUrl, c.change_summary as changeSummary, c.audit_status as auditStatus, c.create_time as submitTime, c.audit_time as auditTime from basket_member_profile_change c
where c.is_delete = 0 and c.change_no like concat('%', #{changeNo}, '%')
and (c.old_nickname like concat('%', #{nickname}, '%') or c.new_nickname like concat('%', #{nickname}, '%'))
and (mp.nickname like concat('%', #{submitUser}, '%') or acc.email like concat('%', #{submitUser}, '%') or acc.account_no like concat('%', #{submitUser}, '%') or p.player_no like concat('%', #{submitUser}, '%'))
and c.audit_status = 1 and c.audit_status = 3 and c.audit_status = 4 and c.audit_status = 5
and c.audit_status = #{auditStatus} and c.create_time >= #{beginTime} and c.create_time <= #{endTime} order by c.create_time desc, c.id desc

select c.id, c.change_no as changeNo, c.member_id as memberId, acc.account_no as accountNo, c.player_id as playerId, p.player_no as playerNo, mp.nickname as submitUserName, acc.email as submitUserEmail, c.old_nickname as oldNickname, c.new_nickname as newNickname, c.old_avatar_file_id as oldAvatarFileId, c.new_avatar_file_id as newAvatarFileId, c.old_avatar_url as oldAvatarUrl, c.new_avatar_url as newAvatarUrl, c.change_summary as changeSummary, c.audit_status as auditStatus, c.create_time as submitTime, c.audit_time as auditTime, c.audit_user_id as auditUserId, c.audit_remark as auditRemark from basket_member_profile_change c
where c.id = #{id} and c.is_delete = 0
select * from basket_member_profile_change where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
mapper.update: update basket_member_profile_change set audit_status = #{toStatus}, audit_user_id = #{auditUserId}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, active_flag = #{activeFlag}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0 and active_flag = 1 and audit_status in #{s}
update basket_member_profile set nickname = #{nickname}, avatar_file_id = #{avatarFileId}, update_time = now() where member_id = #{memberId} and is_delete = 0
